objective: Make widget voice conversation discoverable and usable without the Dashboard, add opt-in silence-ended auto listening, preserve full-band owner voice reference quality, and document evidence-backed Vietnamese TTS upgrade candidates.
non_goals: Do not enable microphone capture until the owner explicitly presses Mic or enables Auto nghe.
Do not retain microphone recordings, transcripts or generated WAV beyond the existing runtime policy.
Do not install WSL/Docker, download an unreviewed model, add cloud credentials or silently switch TTS providers.
Do not claim that three minutes of generated MP3 data is sufficient for production-quality model fine-tuning.
contracts: Widget controls remain hidden at rest and appear beside the avatar on hover/focus.
Manual Mic and Auto nghe are independent explicit owner actions; Auto nghe stops while Hina is thinking or speaking and resumes only after playback ends.
Auto nghe uses bounded in-memory audio, local RMS speech/silence detection and the existing typed STT, chat and TTS IPC routes.
Global mute prevents TTS playback but never fakes a successful synthesis.
The owner voice anchor remains hash-bound, mono and 44.1 kHz to avoid discarding source timbre before VieNeu enrollment.
allowed_dependencies: Existing Electron, Vue, Web Audio, ffmpeg/ffprobe, local STT/chat/TTS routes and current pinned Python dependencies.
acceptance_criteria: Desktop typecheck, unit/security tests and real Electron widget smoke pass.
Hover/focus exposes visible Mic, Auto nghe and Voice buttons adjacent to the avatar.
Auto nghe waits for owner speech, submits after bounded silence, completes STT to chat to TTS, waits for audio playback to end, then rearms.
The regenerated local voice anchor is 44.1 kHz mono and real VieNeu CUDA smoke produces a WAV.
The TTS research note distinguishes Vietnamese support, license, Windows feasibility, latency/VRAM risk and recommends a benchmark order without fake quality claims.
